class Source {
  protected value = 2;
}
class Derived extends Source {
  read(other: Source) {
    const { value } = other;
    const { value: renamed } = other;
    const { inner: { value: nested } } = { inner: other };
    const key = "value";
    const { [key]: computed } = other;
    let assigned = 0;
    ({ value: assigned } = other);
    return value + renamed + nested + computed + assigned;
  }
}
